meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 它会检查数据库和配置文件,把 Slack、Telegram 等消息渠道接到你的 agent 组上,设定隔离级别,还能新增渠道分组,或列出哪些渠道已接、哪些还没接。
howto.when: 在你添加新渠道之后、初始设置过程中,或单独想重新配置渠道接线时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看哪些渠道已经接好了、哪些还没接
say.note: 列出已接、已配置未接、未配置三类

say.text: 把 Telegram 这个群接到现有的 agent 组
say.note: 先问隔离方式,再注册接线

say.text: 把这个渠道挪到另一个 agent 组
say.note: 删旧接线建新接线,旧会话留在原组

howto.what_en: It inspects the database and config files, wires messaging channels like Slack or Telegram to your agent groups, sets isolation levels, and can add channel groups or list which channels are wired or still unconfigured.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you add a channel, during setup, or when you want to reconfigure channel wiring on its own.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are already wired and which aren't
Wire this Telegram group to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Asks the isolation question, then registers

say_en.text: Move this channel to another agent group
say_en.note: Deletes the old wiring, creates a new one
